# Command-local flags after the command path are canonical and do not warn.
exec ./nlm_test betool decode-response --json testdata/betool/response.txt
stdout '"responses"'
! stderr 'before "betool" is deprecated'

# The one-release pre-path compatibility form still works and warns once.
exec ./nlm_test --json betool decode-response testdata/betool/response.txt
stdout '"responses"'
stderr 'nlm: warning: command flag --json before "betool" is deprecated; move it after the command path'

# Multiple pre-path flags produce one ordered, aggregate warning.
exec ./nlm_test --name Title --max-bytes 1 source pack --help
stderr 'nlm: warning: command flags --name, --max-bytes before "source pack" are deprecated; move them after the command path'

# The overloaded -f spelling normalizes only for a resolved owner.
exec ./nlm_test -f prompt.txt chat --help
stderr 'nlm: warning: command flag -f before "chat" is deprecated; move it after the command path'

# A known pre-path flag for a non-owner fails instead of leaking globally.
! exec ./nlm_test --json refresh
stderr 'nlm: flag --json is not valid for "refresh"'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'

# An overloaded -f without an owner is explicitly ambiguous.
! exec ./nlm_test -f prompt.txt refresh
stderr 'nlm: command flag -f before the command path is ambiguous; move it after the command'
stderr 'exit-class=bad-args \(exit 2\)'

# True globals remain valid before and after the command without a placement warning.
exec ./nlm_test --debug betool help
stderr 'nlm: debug mode enabled'
! stderr 'command flag'
exec ./nlm_test betool help --debug
stderr 'nlm: debug mode enabled'
! stderr 'command flag'

# A leading -- ends flag recognition and prevents compatibility normalization.
! exec ./nlm_test -- --json betool help
! stderr 'before "betool" is deprecated'
